name: threadroost-worker
description: Threadroost: a self-hosted MCP connector that hands grok.com and claude.ai conversations to your own bot.

scripts.test: node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/local.test.mjs test/sync.test.mjs test/claim.test.mjs test/bugfix.test.mjs test/loop.test.mjs test/alert.test.mjs test/state.test.mjs

OAUTH_KV.description: Stores OAuth state and buffered turns (text is deleted when your bot acknowledges it, and expires after 72 h). Created automatically; keep the suggested name.

GROKBOT_WEBHOOK_URL.description: The **Webhook URL** of your bot's `courier-inbox` routine. In your bot's chat, say "Show my Threadroost webhook" and open the URL link it sends.

GROKBOT_WEBHOOK_KEY.description: The **webhook key**, from the second link your bot sends. Treat it like a password and never paste it into a chat.

COURIER_PULL_TOKEN.description: A random string of at least 32 characters that your bot uses to pull handoffs. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 32` (or the generator on the setup page) and **keep a copy for your bot**.
